name: Mini me
promptTemplate: Turn this photo into a magical “Mini Me” world where tiny animated versions of yourself come to life around you. These cute 3D-style mini characters interact with your everyday surroundings — climbing onto your shoulders, sitting on your bag, waving, playing, and copying your poses — creating a playful yet emotional social media story-worthy scene full of personality and story. The original photo remains untouched while the tiny characters bring the image to life with depth, movement, realistic shadows, and a soft aesthetic vibe.
promptHints: Photo with a person as main subject
